config.title: Remote & async engineering

intro.title: Remote & async engineering
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple project plan for a remote engineering team, focusing on the core concepts of remote and asynchronous work. You will learn how to structure communication and tasks to operate effectively without being in the same physical location. The main constructs involved include defining clear goals, setting communication protocols, and using basic project management principles. This beginner-friendly lesson will help you understand the foundational practices that enable successful remote and async engineering collaboration.
intro.usecase: Remote & async engineering patterns are essential for distributed teams building modern software products. These patterns appear in collaborative tools like GitHub's pull request workflows, where engineers across time zones review code asynchronously, and in project management platforms like Jira or Linear, where teams track progress without synchronous meetings. Developers implement these patterns when creating real-time dashboards that aggregate data from global services, or when designing notification systems that queue messages for offline team members. Understanding these concepts helps engineering leaders build effective processes for documentation, decision-making, and code reviews that don't depend on everyone being online simultaneously.

objectives: Construct a communication plan for a distributed engineering team
Configure asynchronous collaboration tools for remote workflows
Implement structured documentation for knowledge sharing across time zones
Apply remote-first meeting protocols to maximize team productivity
Initialize a virtual team-building framework to maintain engineering culture
Integrate time-zone aware scheduling systems for global coordination
Manipulate project management tools to track remote team progress
